title: Refactor settings-store.ts — Dynamic provider state with migration
description: Replace flat fields (ollamaEndpoint, ollamaModel, openaiModel, openaiApiKey, anthropicModel, anthropicApiKey) with dynamic providerConfigs + providerApiKeys maps. Add migration from old flat format to new versioned format. Update getActiveLLMConfig to use providerConfigs[activeProvider].
resolution: settings-store.ts refactored to dynamic provider state with migration from old flat format. Dynamic providerConfigs + providerApiKeys maps, getActiveLLMConfig uses providerConfigs[activeProvider].

comments.author: ralph
comments.content:
ISS-0005 complete. Refactored settings-store.ts:
- Replaced flat fields (ollamaEndpoint, ollamaModel, etc.) with dynamic providerConfigs and providerApiKeys maps
- Added migration from old flat format in loadSettings()
- Updated saveSettings() to save all provider API keys dynamically
- Updated getActiveLLMConfig() to use providerConfigs[activeProvider]
- Added saveProviderKey() method
- Verification: lint=0, tests=25/25. 2 type errors in ipc.ts (will be fixed in ISS-0007)
